# Heyup

> Heyup is a tech product discovery and tryout platform where users can test cutting-edge consumer electronics and vote on upcoming releases across smartphones, wearables, smart home, and AI devices.

Heyup specializes in hands-on product testing and community engagement, featuring curated collections from major tech brands like Samsung, Xiaomi, Apple, and Huawei. The platform aggregates products from major tech events (CES 2026, MWC 2026) and maintains real-time trending selections updated by community feedback.

## Product Tryouts & Community

- [Heyup™ Tryouts](https://heyupnow.com/pages/ongoing-tryouts): Test new tech products free and share feedback with the community.
- [2026 March Votelist](https://heyupnow.com/pages/2026-march-votelist): Vote on upcoming products with Heyup Radar community engagement.

## Mobile Devices

- [Smartphones](https://heyupnow.com/collections/smartphones): Browse and try smartphones from Nothing, REDMAGIC, Samsung, Xiaomi, and more.
- [2025 Newest Smartphones and Tablets](https://heyupnow.com/collections/2025-newest-smartphones-and-tablets): Browse 2025 newest smartphones and tablets with cutting-edge technology.

## Tech Collections by Category

- [Wearables](https://heyupnow.com/collections/wearables): Try smartwatches, smart rings, and health-tracking wearables from leading brands.
- [Audio](https://heyupnow.com/collections/audio): Explore premium audio products including headphones, earbuds, and speakers.
- [Smart Home](https://heyupnow.com/collections/smart-home-1): Discover smart home devices for convenience, security, and home automation.
- [AI Devices](https://heyupnow.com/collections/ai-devices): Discover cutting-edge AI devices, wearables, and smart home technology.
- [Computer & Accessories](https://heyupnow.com/collections/computer-accessories): Shop gaming computers, laptops, and computer accessories with latest tech.
- [Tech and Gadgets](https://heyupnow.com/collections/tech-and-gadgets): Try innovative tech gadgets and consumer devices from GameSir and others.
- [Entertainment](https://heyupnow.com/collections/entertainment): Browse gaming devices, projectors, and entertainment tech products.
- [Outdoor & Sports](https://heyupnow.com/collections/outdoor-sports): Explore outdoor gear, sports tech, and adventure equipment for enthusiasts.

## Event Showcases

- [CES 2026](https://heyupnow.com/collections/ces-2026): Discover CES 2026 showcase featuring VR headsets and smart home devices.
- [MWC 2026](https://heyupnow.com/collections/mwc-2026): Explore MWC 2026 products including Honor robots, tablets, and AR glasses.
